description: This file contains the implementation of FalSmartTurnAnalyzer, a class that extends HttpSmartTurnAnalyzer to provide integration with Fal.ai's hosted smart-turn model for end-of-turn detection in conversations. It includes initialization logic, handling of the API endpoint, and deprecation warnings.
